palette.notes: Measured palette_size 1 is an artefact (the still hit the dark end card), so no count. Navy/indigo room, warm orange accents: lamp, oranges, juice, skin.

lighting: One cold ceiling lamp plus blue night window; a warm pool on the counter and the couple; corners fall to deep navy. Cool ambient, warm key.
silhouette: Two figures overlap into one readable shape: boy at the counter, girl hugging from behind; black hair blocks and white shirt vs patterned pajamas keep them apart.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 133.3 ms (p25 116.7, p75 133.3), about 4s at 30 fps, 5.15 drawings/s. Loop of about 8 s, then a TikTok end card fills the rest of the 12 s file.

texture: Clean pixels at 2x (native 288x288 measured); almost no dithering (share 0.0001); rain streaks on the window and wood grain in the floor carry the texture.
camera: Locked-off square wide shot of the whole kitchen; no moves. The scene is the frame.

acting.enters: No entrance; the loop starts mid-action with both already in place.
acting.acts: He squeezes oranges at the counter; she hugs him from behind and leans her head in, swaying. Small repeated gestures, not big poses.
acting.depth: Couple mid-ground left, table and chairs behind right, rain-lit window at the back; depth from overlap and value, not scale changes.

techniques: cool ambient + warm key light on the characters
4s hold timing (about 8 drawings/s) for a calm loop
secondary action: her sway against his working arm
ambient loop props: rain on the window, steam/lamp glow
warm orange accents repeated across the scene to lead the eye
feel: navy room + one warm lamp on the couple + slow 4s two-character loop = cozy domestic calm
for_fred: Give Fred and Pixie a shared tiny loop in one locked wide shot: Fred busy with a task, Pixie leaning on him and swaying on a different beat. Light them warm against a cool room so they read at phone size.
